d.t: A stout whip, especially made of rhinoceros or hippopotamus hide.
d.e: He learnt that he was a slave, in spite of all the petty airs he might assume, a slave shackled to a yoke, to be scolded when he lagged, flogged when he rebelled with the sjambok of the modern driver, Threat of the Sack.

d.t: To whip with a sjambok; to horsewhip.
Scientiae Juridicae Doctor; Doctor of Judicial Science.
